info.title: DwarfAlp ASCOM Alpaca API
info.description: ASCOM Alpaca telescope, camera, focuser and filter-wheel API for DWARF 2, DWARF 3 and DWARF Mini. The API follows Alpaca response envelopes; device-specific behavior is documented in the companion registry.

get.description: Basic health endpoint for monitoring and tests.

put.description: Slew to right ascension and declination. ASCOM Alpaca does not define a target-name parameter for this operation. When NINA's local sky-atlas database is available, DwarfAlp matches both J2000 and current-epoch coordinates and sends the resolved catalogue name (for example M11) to the DWARF instead of Custom.

Start a DWARF exposure. For V3 astronomy captures, delayed firmware code -11514 is treated as a nonfatal warning when the device continues shooting. The result is retrieved as FITS through FTP or through the app-equivalent album mediaType=4, astroImageDetails.srcDir, /album/astro/fitsList sequence.
